description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/central_D1x_periodic driven by problems/advection_2d_x_periodic_central.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) — NX is the open metaparameter (NY is edge-closed at 8; the solution is constant in y and no y-operator appears), and the problem's dx observed and inlined x coordinates use the NX name so the geometry follows each rebinding automatically. The manufactured steady solution sin(2 pi x) is held by the exactly matching forcing (derivation in the problem file); the periodic x-operator is skew-symmetric, so the recorded L2/Linf errors at t=0.1 are pure O(dx^2) truncation drift.
